title: 6 Months of Losses. Then CPI Week Changed Everything.
description: Before CPI hits this week, watch this. One shift in how we read smart money concepts turned 6 months of losses into consistent funded account results. This is the R2F Trading system — and it works. r2ftrading.com
script: I blew 3 funded accounts in 6 months. Same setup. Same mistake. Every single time. I was trading order blocks. But I was entering too early. Before the sweep ever happened. Smart money doesn't move until liquidity is taken. I had no idea what that meant. Until CPI week. CPI dropped. Price spiked up — grabbed buyside liquidity — then reversed hard into a fair value gap. That was the pattern. Sweep the liquidity. Fill the FVG. Enter after confirmation. Not before. One change. Wait for the sweep. The R2F Trading system calls it the kill shot entry. 78% of setups respect it. CPI hits this week. The sweep is coming. Follow R2F Trading — we post the setups before they happen.
